## Summary

Describe the problem and the scoped change that addresses it.

## Testing

List the exact checks you ran. For GTK tests, say whether a display was required
and whether any test skipped.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] User-visible behavior or configuration changes are documented.
- [ ] A targeted regression test was added or an explanation is included.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, fixtures, and examples contain no private mail or secrets.
